Record Class bear5.SaveData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
characters.bear5.SaveData
Record Components:
health - amount of health to be saved
maxHealth - maximal amount of health to be saved
power - amount of power to be saved
maxPower - maximal amount of power to be saved
money - amount of money to be saved
location - location id to be saved
inventory - inventory to be saved
party - party members to be saved
knownMoves - all known moves to be saved
statuses - all statuses to be saved
Enclosing class:
bear5
public static record bear5.SaveData(int health, int maxHealth, int power, int maxPower, int money, String location, Map<String,Integer> inventory, List<String> party, Set<String> knownMoves, Map<String,Integer> statuses) extends Record
A plain-data snapshot of a player, suitable for writing to a save file. Collections are copied, so the snapshot never changes after creation.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
